details: Exact integrality assertions refuted and corrected; Q-linear, torsion-free integral, and all-ring positive-power theorems proved; envelope constructed with universal property for closed linear targets. E.11 records non-linear generality, executed tests, and first uncovered base-dimension-zero instances.

The source is virtually abelian, not arbitrary modern metabelian. Full pro-algebraic/Malcev and divided-power identifications fail. Correct maps, coordinate ring, universal property in its proved scope, rank1 separating examples and finite/nonfinite relative-completion comparisons supplied.

Q-algebra closed-linear theorem and exact torsion-free divided-power criterion proved; all-prime smooth Z/p^2 counterexamples and genuine integral rank5 example proved and computed. Remaining arbitrary non-linear targets specified in E.11.

Actual and dropped-linear-term signed readings have exact rank3 and4 counterexamples.72 degree<=12 cases at2,3,5, rank5 genuine section, A|K and3!|6! alternatives, binomial-basis calculations executed. Added-integral-X rank4 theorem and sharp p^2 bound proved.

Positive-power theorem holds for every ring and closed linear finite-presentation target; affine dilation lemma proved under schematic density. Original arbitrary separated-lfp scope stays precise in E.11, with proved cases, computations and first uncovered base-dimension-zero tests.

Full integral envelope and linear-target universal property constructed. Maps to/from full pro-algebraic, Malcev, rank1 Hall/Lazard, divided-power and Hain finite/reductive relative examples proved; false identifications separated. Unrestricted target universality and unspecified general integral Hall/Lazard functors are not claimed.

Coordinate rings, all fibres, Zhat-points, discrete injection, order12/24 relative abelian-kernel completion computed. Fine signed parameter scheme and rational no-sign automorphism group proved. Integral generator-determination and sign-recovery assertions refuted. E.20 retains both the named signed comparison over the field F2 and the separate Fermat deck-quotient comparison beginning with free F_2 -> (Z/2)^2.

Independent proof for every nilpotent quotient, pro-p and rational unipotent completion; S3 permutation counterexample executed; modular envelope retains its S3 quotient. No claim that this establishes the author historical motivation.

RWZ/Toen theorems verified and reduced to B S; algebraic goodness proved through the finite-index lattice. Explicit induced12-dimensional representation separates full pro-algebraic from quasi-unipotent envelope on S itself.
Mathematical lead proved independently; nilpotent/pro-p approximations miss the change in the S3 covering, while the modular envelope retains that quotient. Modern metabelian scope distinguished.
Discrete S, full P_Q(S), and the quasi-unipotent integral envelope compared on the requested example with exact maps and separating representation.

Proved case: order12/24 modular relative abelian-kernel completion is the finite stage; fine automorphism parameters, a generic identification and two counterexamples are supplied. General targets (Z/n)^2 and S3 x Zhat^* remain uncomputed. The first nontrivial finite deck test is q2: free F_2=<x,y> -> (Z/2)^2, x->(1,0), y->(0,1); comparison of its rational relative completion or abelian-kernel quotient with specified M/N, including the map, image and kernel, is absent. For S3 x Zhat^*, the tower source, continuous quotient map and proconstant or compatible finite-quotient completion category must be fixed. This is only the group-scheme half; no general tower identification is claimed.
